advice: Wear cotton gloves for wet work; avoid detergents and cement. Report lip cracking, bone pain or headache on acitretin. Alternative systemic: methotrexate.

name: Palmoplantar psoriasis

rx.instr: Not in women who may become pregnant (contraception for 3 years after stopping); women avoid alcohol during and 2 months after. Check lipids, LFT
Under cling-film occlusion at night; reduce to alternate days after 4 weeks
